questions.question: Ready for the continuation. When should I measure the new session?

options.label: When you wake me (Recommended)
options.description: I stay idle. You ping me after a clear, an exit, or whenever you want an interim. I then find the new session, snapshot it and add it to the totals (BK-389 66.9 M, RFC-0021 19.0 M).

options.label: Right after it starts
options.description: Ping me once it is running and I take an early snapshot plus a baseline. Costs a little now and protects against losing the transcript.

options.label: Only at the close
options.description: No interim measurements. One snapshot and report once PR #1127 or #1130 is merged or closed.

questions.question: Session 7 proposed `/ship BK-394` (the Memory classes on the contract kernel, accepting ADR-0042), with a prompt that adds context from #1127. Running it before the measuring session is fine. All BK-389 transcripts are already snapshotted, so nothing expires in the meantime. Should I measure BK-394 as its own run with the same method?

options.label: Measure as own run (Recommended)
options.description: When you ping me, I snapshot it with its own PR number and keep its totals separate from BK-389. I note that its prompt is session 7's context prompt, not a bare `/ship BK-394`, and say whether it runs in a fresh worktree or in `gate` again.

options.label: Measure, and use it for done-when 2
options.description: It also counts as one of the extra deliveries in ROADMAP done-when 2. That only works cleanly with a bare `/ship BK-394` in a fresh worktree on latest master, so you would trim the prompt before starting.

options.label: Don't measure it
options.description: I ignore BK-394 and stay idle until the BK-389 measuring session.
